IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas commander Mahmoud Gbayeen in northern Gaza, linked to hostage-holding. Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon (Mayfadoun, al-Khiyam, Mis al-Jabal) with further attacks expected.

sections.executive_summary: The IRGC captured a second US underwater drone in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating maritime tensions. IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas commander Mahmoud Gbayeen in northern Gaza, linked to hostage-holding and recent terror operatives advancement. Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon (Mayfadoun, al-Khiyam, Mis al-Jabal) with preparations for further IDF attacks in the Galilee and Golan.

points: IRGC naval forces intercepted and captured a second US autonomous underwater vehicle involved in espionage in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: presstv/208551).
Iran's Army chief Major General Amir Hatami stated the war is not over and Iranian forces must remain prepared for further heavy strikes against the enemy (Source: presstv/208538).
Iran urged the UN to address European states' complicity in US-Israeli aggression, calling on the organization to address war crimes committed against the Islamic Republic (Source: presstv/208539).
President Pezeshkian questioned negotiating with humiliation after speaking with America, asking whether Iran should go to those who struck it (Source: mamlekate/104646).
PGSA reported charterers forcing vessels to use illegal routes in the Persian Gulf, risking financial and life losses (Source: shin_persian/10472).

IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas military wing commander Mahmoud Hamad Hamad Gbayeen in northern Gaza airstrike; he was involved in holding hostages including Ziv Barman, Itamar Mor, Liri Albag, and others (Source: New_security8200/203964).

Defense Minister Katz instructed military to impose general closure on West Bank, barring Palestinian laborers from entering settlements during Sukkot; essential workers permitted in industrial zones (Source: manniefabian/59251).
Finance Minister Smotrich called on Israeli forces to 'go to war' against Palestinians in the West Bank and do 'as we did' in Gaza (Source: presstv/208547).
Preparations for multiple IDF attacks in Lebanon expected in coming hours targeting western Galilee, upper Galilee, Hula Valley, Rosh Hanikra, possibly Golan (Source: pkpoi/144083).

Former Defense Minister Gallant stated he heard about Egyptian/Egyptian intelligence warnings before 10/7 for the first time in media; denied receiving such warning personally (Source: New_security8200/203960).

Hamas military wing commander Mahmoud Gbayeen killed in northern Gaza airstrike; involved in hostage-holding and advancing terror operatives against IDF and civilians (Source: New_security8200/203964).
Smotrich called for West Bank operations 'as we did in Gaza,' urging Israeli forces to 'go to war' against Palestinians (Source: presstv/208547).
Katz imposed general closure on West Bank during Sukkot; Palestinian workers not permitted to enter communities in Judea and Samaria (Source: manniefabian/59251).

Israeli strikes hit shop at western entrance of Mayfadoun in eastern sector of southern Lebanon via Apache helicopter; simultaneous strikes in al-Khiyam and Mis al-Jabal (Source: New_security8200/203966).
Multiple IDF attacks expected in Lebanon in coming hours; explosions audible in western Galilee, upper Galilee, Hula Valley, Rosh Hanikra, possibly Golan (Source: pkpoi/144083).
High concentration of drones reported in Sumbra area near Ain al-Tina in Lebanon (Source: redlinkleb/45506).
Lebanon internal alert system activated requesting immediate notification of hostile activity including drones and military operations (Source: redlinkleb/45571).
Iraqi official told NBC Iraq is as ready for negotiation as for any aggression, even if it leads to destructive war (Source: SharghDaily/186129).
Iraqi FM stated hope for diplomacy always exists but no reason to return to negotiations given behavior over past two years (Source: SharghDaily/186137).
Sheikh Na'im Qassem praised Nasrallah as the resistance symbol and international commander, vowing to continue his path (Source: naya_foriraq/91771).
Saudi strike in Yemen killed 7 (Source: yediotnews25/135383).
Saudi aggression targeted central Taiz market at Maweya junction (Source: rasedal3ado138e/395389).
France deployed French forces, radar units, and defense systems to Saudi Arabia; Foreign Minister Barrot stated support is purely defensive (Source: SharghDaily/186131).
Record oil flow through Strait of Hormuz exceeded pre-war volumes according to Trump (Source: mamlekate/104655).
IRGC captured second US underwater drone in Strait of Hormuz (Source: presstv/208551).

sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC capture of a second US underwater drone in the Strait of Hormuz signals escalating asymmetric capabilities and maritime tensions. Combined with Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon (Mayfadoun, al-Khiyam, Mis al-Jabal) and preparations for broader IDF operations in the Galilee and Golan, the operational tempo is rising. Iran's Army chief stated the war is not over and forces are prepared for further heavy strikes. The threat extends to maritime security, with PGSA reporting vessels forced onto illegal routes.
sections.regional_response: France deployed radar units and defense systems to Saudi Arabia, claiming a purely defensive posture. Iraq's foreign minister stated hope for diplomacy remains but no reason to return to negotiations given past behavior. Egypt denied warning Israel before 7/10, with the PM office calling Atlantic magazine claims false. Saudi Arabia continued strikes in Yemen, killing 7 in one attack.
sections.intelligence_notes: RAF Fairford security enhanced after unspecified threat; several men arrested on explosives suspicion near the US bomber base, with a FUEL2YOU-branded van inspected by bomb-disposal robot. The Gulf maritime domain shows increased vigilance with PGSA warnings about illegal vessel routes. Lebanon's internal alert system activated for drone and military activity. Romanian F-18s tracked a Russian drone near their airspace, indicating broader regional spillover concerns.
